title: How much do cash transfers improve nutrition?
summary: New research on Kenya finds that cash transfers increase how much very poor households in rural areas spend on food. The response is larger than most previous studies have found, yet the increase is smaller than conventional 'correlational' methods would suggest.

title: Can countries cut air pollution without hurting economic growth?

title: Pairing cash transfers with behaviour change meaningfully improves child nutrition
summary: Pairing peer-led nutrition behaviour-change groups with ongoing cash transfers substantially improved children's diets and development, but meaningful reductions in stunting required combining cash with a larger one-time livelihoods grant.
